kaggle_elo.note: 200-scale Elo, K=10/(N-1) per pair, anchored at current public_score. Matches Kaggle's per-game Δ within ±0.5 for established subs.

convergence.note: At K=10 Elo steady state, rating diff between two subs has std ~28. Gaps above 30 (~2σ) make rank swaps rare; above 60 (~3σ) make them virtually impossible.
